'''Drymoss''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chashima]] and reached up to the ankles of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilot]] [[Voort saBinring]]. In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], saBinring set up an observation nest on a Chashiman hilltop from which he looked out at [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and wide fields of drymoss.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drymoss was mentioned in a flashback in the [[2012]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]] as the tenth and last book in the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] series of novels.<ref name="Mercy Kill" />
